name: Rosha Washington
biography: Rosha Washington is an actor from New Orleans, LA. He is known for playing the Texas legend DJ Screw in a visual tribute entitled All Screwed Up, which is currently being developed by Sony Pictures into a feature film. His other recent projects include Mona Lisa and the Blood Moon (2022), starring Kate Hudson and Craig Robinson; Renfield (2023), starring Nicholas Cage, Awkwafina, and Nicholas Hoult; and Ann Rice's new AMC adaptation of Interview With a Vampire, which will be his TV debut. He also performs regularly in theatrical productions.
